name: Celestial armor design (drakness)

vars.BREAST: a thick crescent moon curving inward and tapering to fine points
vars.HIP: a small moth-wing shape pointing down
vars.ENGRAVING: pale moonstone inlay and a tracery of moth-wing veins

notes: The values that make this hero's celestial armor hers; the four celestial pieces (plate, fitted plate, skin armor, skin suit) fill the shared frames in wardrobe/armor/celestial/frame with them.
